🍻 The Chug Archives

OFFICIAL LEAGUE POLICY · Lowest weekly fantasy score = ESPN record. Beer consumption = photographic folklore. No causal relationship implied.

🍺 The Hall of Shame

2022 · Waffle House

24 hours inside, minus one hour for every waffle eaten. Dylan Pany lost, declined to complete it, and was banned from the league. Rules are rules.

2023 · Waffle House II

Jared Butler actually showed up. Oli Cooke and his daughter Faye helped with the waffles; Faye reportedly ate about three to five. The youngest contributor to league history.

2024 · The Wax

Jason Roberts finished last and had to wax his bum. A season best left in the past.

2025 · The Bear Mile

Tom Gatenby did a mile-long bear crawl wearing a bear costume. Commitment to the bit: undeniable.

2026 · Karaoke Catastrophe

The last-place manager covers the karaoke bar tab, drinks a number of drinks equal to his season losses, and sings in a maid outfit. A proposed league punishment, not a drinking recommendation.

Every week · The Beer Chug

The lowest-scoring manager records a beer chug and shares the video. A longstanding league ritual; weekly offenders can be documented when the records are available.
